25. MOTORISED SEWING MACHINES 
 
 
1. 
Gist of the Scheme 
Motorised Sewing Machines are provided to hearing  
impaired and locomotor disabled persons, mild 
intellectually disabled persons and Mother of  severely 
intellectually disabled persons at  free of cost. 
2. 
Eligibility Criteria 
Should be hearing   impaired or locomotor disability or 
intellectually disabled persons above the age of 18 years 
or Mother of severely intellectually disabled. 
3. 
Whether   form   of   application  
is prescribed 
Yes, Available with the District Differently Abled 
Welfare Offices. 
4. 
Certificates to be furnished 
National Identity Card for Differently Abled and 
Tailoring Certificate are needed. 
5. 
Officer to whom the application 
is to be submitted 
District Differently Abled Welfare Officer 
6. 
Grievances if any to be 
addressed to 
Assistant Director (Placement), 
O/o. The Commissionerate  for Welfare of the 
Differently Abled, 
No.5, Kamarajar Salai, 
Chennai – 600 005.  
Ph: 044-28444940
